principle: Treat the machine PASS and predecessor PASS labels as claims; challenge the actual frozen runtime surfaces and plausible failure paths independently.

challenges.name: challenge_generic_package_manifest_not_yet_current
challenges.detail: Expected WIP state before final evidence/index creation. PACKAGE_MANIFEST_SHA256.json must be regenerated last before candidate freeze.

adversarial_findings: The two photographed iPhone defects remain treated as independent until physical retest: paragraph-target root-scroll contamination and low-height landscape Reader collapse.
The compact-mode design intentionally yields the global bottom navigation, not Reader Back or previous/read/next controls.
Focus is moved to Reader Back before the global navigation is hidden if DOM focus was inside that navigation.
Existing fixed Reader auxiliaries retain their original bottom offset rather than being moved down over the in-flow entry navigation.
The target-position transaction now cancels stale viewport restoration and stale target callbacks, reducing race risk during rotation/navigation.
open_risks: No hosted browser execution has yet exercised the exact v142.16 branch bytes.
No physical iPhone/iPad/PWA execution has yet confirmed Safari geometry and orientation behavior.
VoiceOver must be rechecked because low-height mode can temporarily remove the global bottom navigation from the accessibility tree.
The final generic package manifest is intentionally stale until regenerated after all v142.16 evidence files are written.
